The five Table 1 rows are a transition-analysis subset within a larger AP project group reported as n=12; the table is not a complete attempted-animal denominator.

The article reports group summaries of 230±11 h AP-only, 37±36 h concurrent AP+MV, and 11±10 h MV alone. Table 1 row arithmetic reproduces the concurrent-support summary from the first four rows, while the all-five mean is 52.6 h; the article does not identify the statistic-specific denominator or resolve the fifth row’s inclusion.
The article notes possible selection bias because initial continuation/transition selection required hemodynamic stability after seven support days; case-specific selection status is not mapped.

Table 1 reports complications/outcome narratives without exact event timestamps. Terminal lung assessment/autopsy is not long-term post-support follow-up, and these records do not establish healthy development.
